newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy ready to accept 1,000 lira/mark rate in ERM.
newsitem.headline: Italy ready to accept 1,000 lira/mark rate in ERM.

text.p: Italy lowered its sights on Sunday in an attempt to gain entry to the European Union's Exchange Rate Mechanism, but it had still not won agreement from its EU partners, a diplomat said,.
"The Italians are proposing to come down to 1,000 (lira to the German mark)," a diplomat said referring to the central rate at which the lira would enter the EU's currency grid.
Officials said on Saturday Italy was aiming for a rate of 1,010 lira to the mark.
A Spanish official said Italy's partners were seeking a rate of between 950 to 980 lira to the mark. "Italy is willing to go to 1,000. Other countries are seeking 950 to 980," the official said.
The diplomat said no deal was currently in sight. Germany in particular was objecting, arguing that the Italian government was trying to bring the lira back into the ERM at a weak rate.
"The Germans are not happy," he said.
